A '''religion''' was practiced on the [[Jospro sector/Legends|Jospro sector]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Chad/Legends|Chad]]. The religion was based around the worship of a [[Tsunami/Legends|tsunami]]-causing [[Unidentified Chadra-Fan deity|deity]]. Though all members of the [[Chadra-Fan/Legends|Chadra-Fan]] [[Species/Legends|species]] knew of the religion, by the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Period]] most did not believe in it.<ref name="Stay on Target" />

==Behind the scenes==
The religion was mentioned in [[Stay on Target (sourcebook)|''Stay on Target'']], a [[2014]] sourcebook published by [[Fantasy Flight Games]] for use with the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying]]'' module [[Star Wars: Age of Rebellion (roleplaying game)|''Star Wars: Age of Rebellion'']].<ref name="Stay on Target" />
